name: NanoReads
tagline: NanoReads is a reading app for people who binge stories in short bursts
description: NanoReads is a reading app for people who binge stories in short bursts. The library leans into romance and serialized fiction, from billionaire and CEO leads to slow-burn drama, and every title opens with a few free chapters so you can sample before you commit. Read on the web, iOS, or Android, and your place follows you between devices. Chapters are sized for a 20-30 minute sitting, new stories land weekly, and a distraction-free reader with light and dark modes keeps long sessions comfortable
